mechanism: Persistent Skill Memory of reusable code snippets credited by fitness change, transferred across campaigns
evidence_scope: REFLEX augments the Actor with a persistent, self-evolving Skill Memory—a library of reusable code snippets extracted from elite individuals and credited with the fitness change of the children that use them.
evidence_role: we introduceREFLEX( Reflective Evolution From LLM Experience), a fully train-free evolutionary framework
